Known for its early investments in companies that have gone on to dominate their sectors, including OpenAI, SpaceX and Stripe, the venture capital firm has ‌been looking for ⁠opportunities in large technology companies to expand its public-market holdings.  • Thrive held 904,038 Amazon ⁠shares valued at $215.5 million as of June 30, the filing showed.
